SMTO-AUT-0020 — SMTO has no connected Google account that can do this

GUID: 804ace78-378f-5535-836c-6086ec97375e
Slug: google-account-missing
Domain: AUT · Subsystem: google-workspace

What happened

  • SMTO couldn't find a connected Google account with the access this request needs, or the account name it was given doesn't exist. This doesn't mean anything happened to your Google account itself.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to list your connected Google accounts and the features each one allows. This shows whether any account is connected and whether it covers what you asked for.
  2. If none is listed, or none allows this feature, ask SMTO to connect your Google account for it (for example Calendar or Drive), then finish the Google sign-in page it links to. SMTO only uses Google accounts you have connected and approved for that kind of work.
  3. If you named a specific account, make sure the name exactly matches its Key in Parameter Store, or type @ in the message box and pick it from the list. SMTO looks accounts up by their exact name and never swaps in a different one.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's list of connected Google accounts shows the account with the feature you need, and your request runs without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't connect a different Google account just to make the error go away; SMTO would then act as that account.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Google account resolution failed: no google_account record exists at the requested exact key, or no saved or accepted account satisfies the operation's required features.

What this means

  • Explicit account lookup found no saved record, or automatic selection found no eligible account with the required features. Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.

Why this can happen

  • Explicit account lookup found no saved record, or automatic selection found no eligible account with the required features.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the requested account key and required features with eligible saved account summaries.

How to fix it

  • List accounts with auth.google_accounts and compare their granted features with the operation's required features. Connect or upgrade the intended account with auth.google_connect (or google_calendar.connect / google_drive.connect) for the missing features, or pass the canonical account_ref of an eligible google_account; resolve_account never falls back to a different account.
  • Connect a Google Workspace account with the required features or select an eligible account key.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm account identity and required features before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended saved account resolves and satisfies the operation's required features.

What not to do

  • Do not expose client secrets, tokens, codes or PKCE verifiers.
  • Do not switch accounts or repeat uncertain mutations automatically.

Technical notes

  • Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
